cards.b: NFT marketplace Blur announced it is shutting down its website on November 12, following a 99% collapse in trading volumes from its 2023 peak. Upbit has already suspended Blur deposits after flagging the token for review.

per.BLUR: Website closure and trading volume collapse threaten token utility and market access.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact time of the website closure on November 12.

cards.b: Russia's largest bank, Sberbank, secured regulatory approval and set a December 1 launch date to open crypto trading to all clients, having already tested Bitcoin, Ether, and Tether trades within its mobile app.

per.BTC: Gains regulated institutional entry path in Russia.
per.ETH: Gains regulated institutional entry path in Russia.
per.USDT: Gains regulated institutional entry path in Russia.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Specific trading pairs and liquidity caps for retail users.

cards.t: South Korea Blocks Unregistered Crypto Platforms
cards.b: South Korean regulators have stepped up actions to block access to 27 unregistered crypto exchanges and websites, including KuCoin and Bitmart, warning that local users may experience asset withdrawal difficulties.

per.KCS: Access restrictions in South Korea could impact user liquidity and platform volumes.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact timeline for when network-level DNS blocking will take full effect.

cards.b: ENS is seeking DAO approval to activate an upgraded Ethereum naming system. New .eth registrations will temporarily pause for hours during the transition while existing domain holders can renew without migrating.

per.ENS: New name registrations will experience a brief pause during the protocol upgrade.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact date and time for the governance vote and transition execution.

cards.b: Binance announced it will permanently shut down its crypto mining pool and related services on November 10, urging miners to migrate their hashrate to alternative providers.

per.BTC: Miners must redirect their mining operations to other pools ahead of the service termination.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Impact on overall network hashrate distribution.

cards.b: Metaplanet announced plans to issue $329 million in zero-interest convertible bonds with a five-year maturity to restructure its debt and fund share buybacks without selling its Bitcoin reserves.

per.BTC: Treasury holdings remain protected from forced liquidation as alternative debt financing is utilized.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact issuance date of the convertible bonds.
